subject: Request: extra eval credits for head-to-head benchmark vs AtlasAI
messages:
From: Alice Rogers <alice@cloudsync.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval credits request — head-to-head with AtlasAI

Hi Dylan,

Quick ask from the product team: we're running a tight head-to-head benchmark vs AtlasAI next week as part of an RFP response. The technical team wants a controlled run with identical prompts and logs retained for internal analysis.

Can Redwood extend our trial and grant additional eval credits (we estimate ~200k tokens for repeated runs across 3 models) so we can produce reproducible latencies and output-quality comparisons? If possible we'd also like one short session with an SE to make sure we configure batching and kv cache properly.

Rationale: this will be a public bake-off with our procurement group — strong chance of a multi-year contract if Redwood is competitive on latency + cost. We can share the final benchmark report (non-public until sign-off).

Practical asks:
- 200k evaluation credits (single-use, expires 45 days)
- 2 hours SE assistance during the run
- Confirmation of no public naming of Redwood without our/your approval

Happy to sign any short addendum. Let me know what you need from our side.

Thanks,
Alice Rogers
Director, Integrations
CloudSync

Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Eval credits request — head-to-head with AtlasAI

Team — forwarding a customer request. Quick approval call:

Summary:
- CloudSync wants 200k eval tokens for a head-to-head benchmark vs AtlasAI (RFP).
- They want 2 hours of SE support and a short agreement limiting public naming.

Questions for approval:
- Promo amount OK? (we can mark as one-time test credit, expire 45d)
- Any compliance/marketing constraints we should attach to the grant?

My read: high upside (procurement engaged). Recommend 200k tokens + 2 hrs SE + clause about public naming (we need approval before they publish). If yes I can send a short promo agreement and schedule onboarding.

Thanks — Dylan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Eval credits request — head-to-head with AtlasAI

On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 10:03 AM dylan_brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team — forwarding a customer request. Quick approval call:

Agree with Dylan's recommendation, with a couple of technical caveats:

- 200k tokens is fine for the run but recommend we limit simultaneously concurrent runs to 2 to avoid noisy tail latency in their report.
- SE time: propose 2 x 1-hour blocks (one pre-run tuning, one live support). I'll own the pre-run tuning.
- Logs & data retention: require CloudSync to sign an addendum stating logs will only be used for internal analysis, not public dissemination. If they ask for request-level logs, redact customer PII and get an internal legal thumbs-up.

Also recommend we add a short clause: "Redwood must approve any public benchmark or comparative claim referencing Redwood or Redwood's performance." Keeps marketing safe.

Technically fine to offer a 45-day expiry on credits. Happy to run the session next week (Tue/Wed preferred).

— Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
